test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 13 Feb 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: As of November 2022, who is the Union Minister for Law and Justice in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kiren Rijiju.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Arunachal Pradesh-born** Indian politician **Kiren Rijiju** has represented Arunachal West in the Lok Sabha since 2014 and from 2004 to 2009.
 
• **From July 7, 2021, to May 18, 2023**, he served as the **34th Minister of Law and Justice**, succeeding **Ravi Shankar Prasad.**
 
• **Currently**, he has been serving as the Government of India's **Cabinet Minister for Earth Sciences**.
 
• Indian politician **Arjun Ram Meghwal** has been the Government of India's **Minister of Law and Justice (Independent Charge) since 2023**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Alongside** Ajit Pawar, Devendra Gangadharrao Fadnavis** is an Indian politician from the Bhartiya Janta Party who will take over as **Maharashtra's deputy chief minister on June 30, 2022**. Moreover, he governed **Maharashtra **as its **18th chief minister from October 31, 2014, to November 12, 2019.**
 
• Since 2021, **Ashwini Vaishnaw,** an Indian politician and former IAS officer, has held the positions of **39th Minister of Railways, 55th Minister of Communications, and 2nd Minister of Electronics and Information Technology** in the Government of India. He has also served as an **Odisha** representative in the Rajya Sabha since 2019. 
 
• As a cabinet minister in the Indian government, **Piyush Vedprakash Goyal** is a politician and chartered accountant from India. He held the positions of **Minister of Railways, Minister of Commerce and Industry, and Minister of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution**. He is the **current Leader of the House in the Rajya Sabha** in addition to being a member of parliament for the state of Maharashtra. **Currently,** He is the **Minister of Textiles.**
